import json, urllib.request

UA = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36",
      "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

vh = "QVQLQQSAAELARPGASVKMSCKASGYSFTTYTIHWVKQRPGQGLEWIGYINPSSGYAAYNQNFKDETTLTADPSSSTAYMELNSLTSEDSAVYYCAREKFYGYDYWGQGATLTVSS"
vl = "DVLMTQIPLSLPVSLGDQASISCRSSQSIVHRNGNTYLEWYLLKPGQSPKLLIYKVSNRFSGVPDRFSGSGSGTDFTLKISRVEAEDLGVYYCFQGSHVPYTFGGGTKLEI"

def seq_search(seq, identity=0.9, label=""):
    body = {
        "sequence": seq,
        "evalue_cutoff": 0.001,
        "identity_cutoff": identity,
        "hitlist_query": [{"type": "terminal", "service": "sequence"}],
        "request_options": {"paginate": {"start": 0, "rows": 30}, "scoring_strategy": "sequence"},
    }
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/sequence",
                                 data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers=UA)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            d = json.load(r)
        hits = d.get("result_list", d.get("hits", []))
        print(f"--- {label}: {len(hits)} hits")
        for h in hits[:30]:
            sid = h.get("identifier")
            if isinstance(sid, list):
                sid = ",".join(str(x) for x in sid)
            print(f"  {sid}  score={h.get('score')}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"--- {label}: ERROR {e}")

seq_search(vh, 0.9, "VH (90%)")
seq_search(vh, 0.5, "VH (50%)")
seq_search(vl, 0.9, "VL (90%)")

import json, time, urllib.request, urllib.parse

UA = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) kodact/1.0"}
BASE = "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/services/rest/blast"

VH = "QVQLQQSAAELARPGASVKMSCKASGYSFTTYTIHWVKQRPGQGLEWIGYINPSSGYAAYNQNFKDETTLTADPSSSTAYMELNSLTSEDSAVYYCAREKFYGYDYWGQGATLTVSS"
VL = "DVLMTQIPLSLPVSLGDQASISCRSSQSIVHRNGNTYLEWYLLKPGQSPKLLIYKVSNRFSGVPDRFSGSGSGTDFTLKISRVEAEDLGVYYCFQGSHVPYTFGGGTKLEI"

def submit(seq, name):
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({"sequence": ">query\n" + seq, "data_format": "fasta"}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/submit/blastp", data=data, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        job = r.read().decode().strip()
    print(f"{name}: job {job}", flush=True)
    return job

def poll(job, tries=60, wait=5):
    for i in range(tries):
        req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + f"/status/{job}", headers=UA)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            st = r.read().decode().strip()
        if st != "WAIT" and st != "RUNNING":
            return st
        time.sleep(wait)
    return "TIMEOUT"

def result(job, name):
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + f"/result/{job}/xml", headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        txt = r.read().decode()
    with open(f"blast_{name}.xml", "w") as f:
        f.write(txt)
    import re
    hits = re.findall(r'accession="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([^<]*)</Def>[^>]*', txt)
    print(f"== {name}: {len(hits)} hits, first 15:")
    for acc, desc in hits[:15]:
        print(acc, "|", desc[:110], flush=True)

for seq, name in [(VH, "vh"), (VL, "vl")]:
    try:
        job = submit(seq, name)
        st = poll(job)
        print(f"{name}: status {st}", flush=True)
        if st == "FINISHED":
            result(job, name)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{name}: ERROR {e}", flush=True)
        try:
            print(e.read().decode()[:800], flush=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
print("ALL DONE", flush=True)

import random, re, sys

random.seed(42)

def read_fasta(path):
    seqs = {}
    name = None
    for line in open(path):
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith(">"):
            name = line[1:].split("|")[0]
            seqs[name] = []
        elif name:
            seqs[name].append(line)
    return {k: "".join(v) for k, v in seqs.items()}

# --- subprotein sequences ---
clover = read_fasta("/app/work/pdb/5WJ2.fasta")["5WJ2_1"]
mcherry = read_fasta("/app/work/pdb/2H5Q.fasta")["2H5Q_1"]
hras = read_fasta("/app/work/pdb/5P21.fasta")["5P21_1"]

gb = open("/app/plasmid.gb").read()
m = re.search(r"feature_key\s*=\s*CDS.*?/translation\s*=\s*\n\s*(\S+)", gb, re.S)
dhfr = m.group(1)

print("raw lengths:", len(clover), len(mcherry), len(hras), len(dhfr))
assert clover.startswith("M") and mcherry.startswith("M") and hras.startswith("M") and dhfr.startswith("M")

flag = "DYKDDDDK"  # FLAG tag, antigen of anti-FLAG M2 (7BG1/8RMO)

clover_p = clover[1:].replace("X", "W")     # N-term Met removed, chromophore X -> single W
mcherry_p = mcherry[1:].replace("X", "Y")   # N-term Met removed, chromophore X -> single Y
dhfr_p = dhfr[1:]
hras_p = hras[1:]

LINK = "GGGGSGGGGS"  # 10-aa GS linker
parts = [flag, LINK, clover_p, LINK, dhfr_p, LINK, mcherry_p, LINK, hras_p]
protein = "".join(parts)
print("protein length:", len(protein))
print("expected nt:", len(protein) * 3)

# --- codon optimization ---
CODONS = {
    "A": ["GCA", "GCT", "GCC", "GCG"],
    "R": ["CGT", "CGC", "CGA", "CGG", "AGG", "AGA"],
    "N": ["AAT", "AAC"],
    "D": ["GAT", "GAC"],
    "C": ["TGT", "TGC"],
    "Q": ["CAA", "CAG"],
    "E": ["GAA", "GAG"],
    "G": ["GGT", "GGA", "GGC", "GGG"],
    "H": ["CAT", "CAC"],
    "I": ["ATT", "ATC", "ATA"],
    "L": ["CTG", "CTT", "CTC", "CTA", "TTA", "TTG"],
    "K": ["AAA", "AAG"],
    "M": ["ATG"],
    "F": ["TTT", "TTC"],
    "P": ["CCT", "CCA", "CCC", "CCG"],
    "S": ["TCT", "TCC", "TCA", "TCG", "AGT", "AGC"],
    "T": ["ACT", "ACC", "ACA", "ACG"],
    "W": ["TGG"],
    "Y": ["TAT", "TAC"],
    "V": ["GTT", "GTC", "GTA", "GTG"],
}
def gc(c): return sum(ch in "GC" for ch in c)

# initial: pick codon with gc closest to 1.5, deterministic tie-break by position
def initial():
    out = []
    for i, aa in enumerate(protein):
        opts = CODONS[aa]
        if len(opts) == 1:
            out.append(opts[0]); continue
        best = min(opts, key=lambda c: (abs(gc(c) - 1.5), (gc(c) != (i % 2) + 1)))
        out.append(best)
    return out

codons = initial()
seq = "".join(codons)

def bad_windows(s, lo=15, hi=35):
    bad = []
    g = [1 if c in "GC" else 0 for c in s]
    w = sum(g[:50])
    if w < lo or w > hi: bad.append((0, w))
    for i in range(1, len(s) - 49):
        w += g[i + 49] - g[i - 1]
        if w < lo or w > hi: bad.append((i, w))
    return bad

for round_ in range(200):
    bad = bad_windows(seq)
    if not bad:
        break
    for (i, w) in bad:
        too_low = w < 15
        # codons overlapping window [i, i+50)
        c0, c1 = i // 3, (i + 49) // 3 + 1
        improved = False
        for ci in range(c0, c1):
            aa = protein[ci]
            opts = CODONS[aa]
            if len(opts) < 2: continue
            cur = codons[ci]
            # pick synonym that moves GC in desired direction
            if too_low:
                cand = [c for c in opts if gc(c) > gc(cur)]
                if cand: codons[ci] = max(cand, key=gc); improved = True; break
            else:
                cand = [c for c in opts if gc(c) < gc(cur)]
                if cand: codons[ci] = min(cand, key=gc); improved = True; break
        if not improved:
            # nudge any adjustable codon in the window by 1 step in desired direction
            for ci in range(c0, c1):
                aa = protein[ci]
                opts = CODONS[aa]
                if len(opts) < 2: continue
                cur = codons[ci]
                gcs = sorted({gc(c) for c in opts})
                curg = gc(cur)
                target = max(gcs) if too_low else min(gcs)
                if target != curg:
                    step = [c for c in opts if (gc(c) == curg + (1 if too_low else -1))]
                    if step: codons[ci] = step[0]; improved = True; break
    seq = "".join(codons)

final_bad = bad_windows(seq)
print("after optimize: len", len(seq), "bad windows (15-35):", len(final_bad))
# check against the strict 30-70% (15-35 of 50)
strict_bad = bad_windows(seq, 15, 35)
g = [1 if c in "GC" else 0 for c in seq]
ws = [sum(g[i:i+50]) for i in range(len(seq) - 49)]
print("GC window min/max (of 50):", min(ws), max(ws))
print("first codon:", seq[:3], "last codon:", seq[-3:])
inframe_stops = [i for i in range(0, len(seq) - 2, 3) if seq[i:i+3] in ("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")]
print("in-frame stops:", inframe_stops)

open("/app/work/gblock_seq.txt", "w").write(seq)
open("/app/work/protein_seq.txt", "w").write(protein)
print("WROTE /app/work/gblock_seq.txt and protein_seq.txt")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent verification of /app/work/gblock_seq.txt against all task constraints."""
import re
import urllib.request

BASES = "TCAG"
AA = "FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
TABLE = {}
for i, a in enumerate(AA):
    TABLE[BASES[i // 64] + BASES[(i // 16) % 4] + BASES[i % 4]] = a


def translate(s):
    return "".join(TABLE[s[i:i + 3]] for i in range(0, len(s), 3))


def read_fasta_first(path):
    lines = open(path).read().splitlines()
    seqs, cur = [], []
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith(">"):
            if cur:
                seqs.append("".join(cur))
            cur = []
        elif l.strip():
            cur.append(l.strip())
    if cur:
        seqs.append("".join(cur))
    return seqs[0]


def api_fasta(pid):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}",
        headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
                               "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120 Safari/537.36"},
    )
    return urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read().decode()


seq = open("/app/work/gblock_seq.txt").read().strip()
assert set(seq) <= set("ACGT"), "non-ACGT chars"
assert len(seq) <= 3000, f"too long: {len(seq)}"
assert len(seq) % 3 == 0, "not a multiple of 3"

# --- source sequences ---
clover = read_fasta_first("/app/work/pdb/5WJ2.fasta")
mcherry = read_fasta_first("/app/work/pdb/2H5Q.fasta")
hras = read_fasta_first("/app/work/pdb/5P21.fasta")
gb = open("/app/plasmid.gb").read()
dhfr = re.sub(r"\s", "", re.search(r'/translation="\s*([A-Za-z\s]+?)"', gb, re.S).group(1))

assert clover.count("X") == 1 and clover.index("X") == 65, "5WJ2 chromophore position"
assert mcherry.count("X") == 1 and mcherry.index("X") == 65, "2H5Q chromophore position"
assert clover[0] == "M" and mcherry[0] == "M" and hras[0] == "M" and dhfr[0] == "M"

# --- PDB API re-fetch: staged FASTA must match live API ---
for pid, staged in (("5WJ2", clover), ("2H5Q", mcherry), ("5P21", hras)):
    api = api_fasta(pid)
    api_all = "".join(l.strip() for l in api.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">")).strip()
    assert staged in api_all, f"{pid}: staged seq not in API fasta"
    api_first = "".join(api.splitlines()[1].split()[1:]).strip() if len(api.splitlines()) > 1 else ""
    print(f"  {pid}: API fasta OK (contains staged {len(staged)}-aa seq)")

# --- expected fusion: binder(FLAG) - donor(Clover) - DHFR - acceptor(mCherry) - molbinder(H-Ras) ---
FLAG = "DYKDDDDK"
LINK = "GGGGSGGGGS"
exp = (FLAG + LINK
       + clover[1:].replace("X", "W") + LINK
       + dhfr[1:] + LINK
       + mcherry[1:].replace("X", "Y") + LINK
       + hras[1:])

prot = translate(seq)
assert prot == exp, f"translation mismatch: {len(prot)} vs {len(exp)}"
assert prot == open("/app/work/protein_seq.txt").read().strip()

# --- structure: 4 GS linkers, each 5-20 aa, between every subprotein, none at termini ---
parts = prot.split(LINK)
assert len(parts) == 5, f"expected 5 segments, got {len(parts)}"
assert parts[0] == FLAG
assert parts[1] == clover[1:].replace("X", "W")
assert parts[2] == dhfr[1:]
assert parts[3] == mcherry[1:].replace("X", "Y")
assert parts[4] == hras[1:]
for i, p in enumerate(parts):
    assert not re.fullmatch(r"[GS]+", p), f"segment {i} is itself a linker"
assert not re.fullmatch(r"[GS]+", prot[:20]) or prot.startswith("D"), "N-term must not be a GS linker"
assert not prot.startswith(LINK) and not prot.endswith(LINK)
assert not prot.endswith(("G", "S")) and not prot.startswith(("G", "S")), "termini look linker-like"
print("  segments:", [len(p) for p in parts], "linkers: 4 x 10 aa (5-20 OK)")

# --- start/stop codons ---
assert seq[:3] != "ATG", "gBlock starts with ATG"
stops = [i for i in range(0, len(seq), 3) if seq[i:i + 3] in ("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")]
assert not stops, f"in-frame stops at {stops}"

# --- GC 30-70% in every 50-nt window ---
gc = [sum(1 for c in seq[i:i + 50] if c in "GC") for i in range(len(seq) - 49)]
bad = [i for i, g in enumerate(gc) if not (15 <= g <= 35)]
assert not bad, f"bad GC windows at {bad[:5]}..."
print(f"  GC windows: {len(gc)} windows, min {min(gc)}/50 ({min(gc)*2}%), max {max(gc)}/50 ({max(gc)*2}%)")

print(f"ALL CHECKS PASSED: len={len(seq)} nt, protein {len(prot)} aa, "
      f"first codon {seq[:3]}, last codon {seq[-3:]}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent verification of /app/work/gblock_seq.txt against all task constraints."""
import re
import urllib.request

BASES = "TCAG"
AA = "FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
TABLE = {}
for i, a in enumerate(AA):
    TABLE[BASES[i // 64] + BASES[(i // 16) % 4] + BASES[i % 4]] = a


def translate(s):
    return "".join(TABLE[s[i:i + 3]] for i in range(0, len(s), 3))


def read_fasta_first(path):
    lines = open(path).read().splitlines()
    seqs, cur = [], []
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith(">"):
            if cur:
                seqs.append("".join(cur))
            cur = []
        elif l.strip():
            cur.append(l.strip())
    if cur:
        seqs.append("".join(cur))
    return seqs[0]


def api_fasta(pid):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}",
        headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
                               "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120 Safari/537.36"},
    )
    return urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read().decode()


seq = open("/app/work/gblock_seq.txt").read().strip()
assert set(seq) <= set("ACGT"), "non-ACGT chars"
assert len(seq) <= 3000, f"too long: {len(seq)}"
assert len(seq) % 3 == 0, "not a multiple of 3"

# --- source sequences ---
clover = read_fasta_first("/app/work/pdb/5WJ2.fasta")
mcherry = read_fasta_first("/app/work/pdb/2H5Q.fasta")
hras = read_fasta_first("/app/work/pdb/5P21.fasta")
gb = open("/app/plasmid.gb").read()
dhfr = re.sub(r"\s", "", re.search(r'/translation="\s*([A-Za-z\s]+?)"', gb, re.S).group(1))

assert clover.count("X") == 1, "5WJ2 must have exactly one chromophore X"
assert mcherry.count("X") == 1, "2H5Q must have exactly one chromophore X"
assert clover[0] == "M" and mcherry[0] == "M" and hras[0] == "M" and dhfr[0] == "M"

# --- PDB API re-fetch: staged FASTA must match live API ---
for pid, staged in (("5WJ2", clover), ("2H5Q", mcherry), ("5P21", hras)):
    api = api_fasta(pid)
    api_all = "".join(l.strip() for l in api.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">")).strip()
    assert staged in api_all, f"{pid}: staged seq not in API fasta"
    print(f"  {pid}: API fasta OK (contains staged {len(staged)}-aa seq)")

# --- expected fusion: binder(FLAG) - donor(Clover) - DHFR - acceptor(mCherry) - molbinder(H-Ras) ---
FLAG = "DYKDDDDK"
LINK = "GGGGSGGGGS"
exp = (FLAG + LINK
       + clover[1:].replace("X", "W") + LINK
       + dhfr[1:] + LINK
       + mcherry[1:].replace("X", "Y") + LINK
       + hras[1:])

prot = translate(seq)
assert prot == exp, f"translation mismatch: {len(prot)} vs {len(exp)}"
assert prot == open("/app/work/protein_seq.txt").read().strip()

# --- structure: 4 GS linkers, each 5-20 aa, between every subprotein, none at termini ---
parts = prot.split(LINK)
assert len(parts) == 5, f"expected 5 segments, got {len(parts)}"
assert parts[0] == FLAG
assert parts[1] == clover[1:].replace("X", "W")
assert parts[2] == dhfr[1:]
assert parts[3] == mcherry[1:].replace("X", "Y")
assert parts[4] == hras[1:]
for i, p in enumerate(parts):
    assert not re.fullmatch(r"[GS]+", p), f"segment {i} is itself a linker"
assert not re.fullmatch(r"[GS]+", prot[:20]) or prot.startswith("D"), "N-term must not be a GS linker"
assert not prot.startswith(LINK) and not prot.endswith(LINK)
assert not prot.endswith(("G", "S")) and not prot.startswith(("G", "S")), "termini look linker-like"
print("  segments:", [len(p) for p in parts], "linkers: 4 x 10 aa (5-20 OK)")

# --- start/stop codons ---
assert seq[:3] != "ATG", "gBlock starts with ATG"
stops = [i for i in range(0, len(seq), 3) if seq[i:i + 3] in ("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")]
assert not stops, f"in-frame stops at {stops}"

# --- GC 30-70% in every 50-nt window ---
gc = [sum(1 for c in seq[i:i + 50] if c in "GC") for i in range(len(seq) - 49)]
bad = [i for i, g in enumerate(gc) if not (15 <= g <= 35)]
assert not bad, f"bad GC windows at {bad[:5]}..."
print(f"  GC windows: {len(gc)} windows, min {min(gc)}/50 ({min(gc)*2}%), max {max(gc)}/50 ({max(gc)*2}%)")

print(f"ALL CHECKS PASSED: len={len(seq)} nt, protein {len(prot)} aa, "
      f"first codon {seq[:3]}, last codon {seq[-3:]}")
